Meeting Minutes Maker

Turn rough notes into structured meeting minutes — attendees, decisions, and action items with owners and due dates. Copy or download.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the meeting title, date, and attendees.
  2. Add decisions and action items.
  3. Copy or download the finished minutes.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What sections are included?

The meeting title, date, attendees, key discussion points, decisions made, and action items with owners and due dates.

How do action items work?

Action items each get an owner and a due date, so nothing falls through the cracks.

Can I remove entries?

Yes — remove any decision or action item with its ✕ button.

How do I share the minutes?

Copy the formatted minutes or download them as a .txt file.
